Use `lookup(var.instance_types, var.environment, "t3.nano")` to retrieve the instance type corresponding to the environment.
In `templatefile`, pass `${path.module}/userdata.sh.tftpl` as the first argument, and `{ server_name = "${var.environment}-server" }` as the second argument.
For `tags`, use `merge({ Name = "${var.environment}-web", Environment = var.environment }, var.extra_tags)`.
